difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for algebraic spaces G -> F with G -> F representable, a surjective etale q : U -> F and V = G x_F U, a property P of the relative-representable-property type holds for G -> F if and only if it holds for V -> U (source lines 1964-1975). The proof gives the direct argument: one direction is immediate from stability under base change, and for the converse one takes T -> F, forms the scheme T' = T x_F G, writes the two-square commutative diagram relating T' -> T to V -> U, reads property P off the middle arrow as a base change, and applies locality of P on the base to the fppf covering T x_F U -> T.
